resources.string: When this device has too few resources to accept another device from the circle.
This device has reached the system limit of open connections. It does not accept new devices from the circle right now (refused: %1$d). Close an app or restart Safeer.
This device is running out of memory. It does not accept new devices from the circle right now (refused: %1$d). Close an app; devices connect by themselves once there is room again.
Safeer Link: the system allows no more tasks
The system allows no more simultaneous tasks (threads). New devices from the circle are not accepted right now (refused: %1$d). Close an app or restart Safeer.
The device “%1$s” has too few resources (connections or memory) for a new connection right now. I will try again by myself.
Private, faster torrents – enter your API key
Key entered – torrents play through TorBox

With TorBox, torrents are downloaded by TorBox’s servers: your device is not in the swarm, so your IP address stays hidden, and the stream is faster and steadier. Paste your API key from torbox.app (Settings → API). The key is stored encrypted on this device only.
That doesn’t look like an API key.
%1$s rejected the API key. Check it in My sources → Debrid services.
TorBox limit reached (60 new torrents per hour). Try again in %1$d min.
Your %1$s plan’s download limit has been reached.
Your %1$s plan does not allow this download.
%1$s found no playable file in this torrent.
%1$s is still downloading this torrent. Try again in a few minutes – then it will play right away.
The add-on could not do this.
The add-on has no more details.
Some settings could not be saved
Developer mode is on – add-ons on a local address allowed

For people who build add-ons: install an add-on from a local address (http://192.168.x.x:port/manifest.json), reload add-ons without reinstalling, and see a log of add-on responses (no stream links or settings). Long-press Add-ons again to turn it off.
Private, faster torrents – add a key (TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid)

A debrid service downloads the torrent for you: your device is not in the swarm, so your IP stays hidden, and the stream is faster. Add the key of at least one service. If several have the film, Safeer measures their speed to this device and plays from the fastest. ⚡ marks sources that are ready to play.
%1$s – key not valid – enter it again
%1$s rejected the key – it was not saved. Check it and enter it again.
No connection to %1$s – the key is saved as unverified and is not sent to your other devices until the service confirms it.
Get your key at %1$s. It is stored encrypted on this device only.
None of your services has this ready yet, and “Instant only” is on. Choose “Wait for download” to let the service download it first.
The saved %1$s key can no longer be read on this device (secure storage). Enter it again.
None of your devices in Safeer Link is in this device’s inner circle – keys not sent. Add a device in Settings → Inner circle of trust.
Debrid services could not play this
Send your keys (%1$s) to %2$s? They travel encrypted from device to device; %2$s saves them only after you confirm there.
%1$s has no encrypted device-to-device connection – keys not sent
%1$s does not allow this device – give it full access in Safeer Link
Debrid keys from another device are waiting – open Media Center to confirm
%1$s sent you debrid keys: %2$s. Save them on this device?
Play torrents via (⚡ = ready to play)

Enter your indexer’s address and API key. Safeer searches it for Usenet sources and plays them through TorBox (Pro plan). Your indexer key stays on this device: Safeer downloads the NZB file itself and sends only the file to TorBox.
Check the address (https://…) and the API key.
Usenet did not work – playing another source
Webtor did not work – playing another source
The add-on could not be saved securely (encryption failed). Try again.
cannot be unlocked on this device – the add-on has to be added again (%1$s)
Keys sent – confirm on %1$s. Add-ons with a personal token were not sent: update Safeer on %1$s first.
Sync keys and add-ons in the inner circle automatically: on
Sync keys and add-ons in the inner circle automatically: off
No device in your inner circle of trust syncs keys and add-ons yet.
%1$s – waiting for confirmation on that device
%1$s – older Safeer: update it there (keys can still be sent manually)
%1$s (inner circle of trust) wants to sync keys and add-ons with this device: %2$s. Accept once – later changes and deletions on either device apply automatically.
This device\'s keys and add-ons will also go to %1$s.
%1$s wants to sync keys and add-ons – open Media Center to confirm
%1$s: confirmation will be shown again at the next sync
The Usenet indexer did not return the NZB file. Check its API key and daily limit.
The address field contains an API key, not an address – it was not saved or sent anywhere. Paste the key into the API key field and enter the indexer name as the address (e.g. nzbfinder.ws).
The indexer address is not valid – enter a name with a domain (e.g. nzbfinder.ws) or a full https://… address.
The %1$s key was removed on this device only – it was not valid here, so your other devices in the inner circle keep theirs.
%1$s could not check the key right now – your current valid key stays in use. Safeer checks the new one again and uses it only once the service confirms it.
new key waiting to be checked
the service rejected the new key – the previous one is in use
